title: Tetragrammaton Records 8-track tape for the Bill Cosby comedy album 8:15 12:15
descriptionText: The Tetragrammaton Records 8-track tape for the Bill Cosby comedy album "8:15 12:15" features a classic recording of the iconic comedian's humor. This vintage format allows listeners to enjoy Cosby's witty remarks in a nostalgic way, as the 8-track cartridge captures his unique style and entertainment. With the record label being Track Record, this release showcases the talent of Bill Cosby and the comedic genius that he brought to the genre.
